method: private build on a fresh snapshot of the integrated build (scratch/detail/receiver_right/base.blend = scratch/AR01_review.blend + form_tris.npz of 2026-10-05 02:54/03:00; the old form snapshot is kept as base_formsnap.*), parts/receiver_right_run.py iterations r2b0 (baseline = committed code) .. r2b8; c1 part camera = the r2 registration (shift only; a free-scale landmark fit gives k 0.968, rejected: the vertical mismatch is c1's drawing, not scale)
changes: ejection port = ONE slot from the cover's traced skirt step (X ~304-313) to X 452: the right wall is cut from the step line (0.3 behind the skirt edge, hidden by it) up to Z 9.2 and full height from X 336.5; skirt bottom ahead of the step 10.3/10.6 -> 9.6; the skirt cutout lifts on a slant to Z 12.3 at X 334-337 and rises to Z 19.2 at X 372-378.5 (r1's rise position, as the side panel draws it). Side panel at 16x: a black band Z ~6.5-10.5 starts at the step's slant; c1: one slot with one slanted rear end. r2's stepped rear (black block under a separate tall notch) is gone; carrier and travel back to r2 values (rear 346, travel 103.25)

carrier: flank recess extended down to the carrier bottom (Z -4.5); right guide rail gapped at X 361-383 behind the notch, so the notch under the port shows a dark interior (judge r1: 'a shallow shield-shaped engraved outline')
notch: r1 drop shape kept (c1 at 9x confirms it), top Z 1.8 -> 2.3 (hangs from the port's bottom line), pressed lip 1.3 -> 0.9
rivet heads: low domes (judge r1: 'domed with highlights'), 10 segments right, 8 left, 3 rings (budget)
right flush pin: the engraved ring is replaced by a domed head r 1.75, 0.6 proud (judge r1: 'small domed screw'; a ring cut drew radial shading streaks on the flat wall)
retainer clip: long hairpin loop 11.6 x 2.6 mm, round rear end, upper leg with a down-curl, longer lower leg with an up-turn, wire 0.92 (judge r1: 'raised loop of wire', ours 'a tiny flat hook mark')

right dimple 0.85 -> 1.5 deep on a 1.0 inner block behind the wall (judge r1: 'deep round hole' vs 'shallow bulge'); cut after the bevel passes; the unseen inner bottom corner along the block is not bevelled (its 1.6 ring crossed the block and made the 0.3 pass throw vertices)
receiver rear vertical outer edges rolled 1.5 (side panel: a bright rolled rear edge; judge: 'rounded transition' vs 'plain cut slab')
judge_r1_tells_addressed: port: one long slot with one slanted rear end, lit carrier bar over a dark band
not_addressed: selector lever / pivot / tip rivet, trigger, trigger guard, grip, magazine ribs, the trigger guard's front flange plate: other parts
loop at the cover's top-left corner: c1 only; the side panel at 12x shows the cover's rear lip and the button, no loop (position authority): not built
c1 draws the receiver ~15 % taller (cover top to receiver bottom) than the spec at the same horizontal scale (rivet landmarks): proportion is the spec's / side view's, not changed
mag catch: c1 draws a slim tab under a wider housing; the side trace (L2 thin-part contour gate) draws the wedge we build: not changed
dust_cover L2 per-part IoU fell 0.9648 -> 0.9503 (skirt 9.6, cutout rise moved forward): still passes, little margin
materials (bright rivet crowns, wear, AO in recesses): ROUGH LOOK only
